item.title: Fly tipping. Keeps getting changed to fixed but its still there !, 14th October
item.description:
This keeps getting changed to fixed but its not fixed! Someone has left a bunch of rubbish bags on the ground beside our bins outside the house. Foxes have gotten into them and as a result rubbish keeps drifting out down my driveway. None of the tenants of the 76 shooters hill road building claim responsibility but it's an eyesore and messy. The refuse collectors are rightly not lifting it because it's not in a bin but unsure what im able to do about it.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Shooters Hill Road, Blackheath
